hha.info.overview.title: Hell's Armory — Help
hha.info.overview.1: All Hell's/Heaven's armor is upgraded at a smithing table exclusively from Netherite armor.
hha.info.overview.2: Set keys: Ability 1 = beam, Ability 2 = Fire Camp, Ability 3 = Ultra (defaults G/H/U); weapon abilities use right-click.
hha.info.overview.3: /info abilities explains all shared, Hell's, Heaven's, and Ultra abilities.
hha.info.overview.4: /info commands explains every player and admin command.
hha.info.overview.5: /info all displays the complete help at once.
hha.info.commands.title: Commands
hha.info.commands.3: /untrust <player> — removes that protection. Your area abilities spare trusted players.
hha.info.commands.4: /hha kit hell|heaven — gives the selected SMP kit while kit mode is enabled.
hha.info.commands.5: Admin: /hha list displays all enabled abilities and numeric values.
hha.info.commands.6: Admin: /hha toggle <key> <true|false> enables or disables an ability.
hha.info.commands.7: Admin: /hha set <key> <number> changes values; e.g. light_wave_knockback controls knockback.
hha.info.commands.8: Admin: /hha get <key> reads one value; /hha reset restores every default.
hha.info.general.title: Shared Armor Abilities
hha.info.general.1: Helmet: Regeneration I. Chestplate: Fire Resistance. Boots: Speed I and no fall damage.
hha.info.general.2: A complete Hell's or Heaven's set raises your maximum health from 10 to 20 hearts.
hha.info.general.3: Ability 1 activates the set beam; Ability 3 activates Ultra while wearing a complete set.
hha.info.general.4: Cooldown icons above the hotbar show set and weapon abilities: colored = ready, dark = cooling down.
hha.info.general.5: Trusted players and your own summoned allies are spared by your harmful abilities.
hha.info.general.6: Non-OPs permanently bind to Hell or Heaven when first possessing a set item; server operators bypass the lock.
hha.info.general.7: Opposing items may stay in your inventory, but require Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots, Sword, and Mace before use; first use switches faction.
hha.info.hell.title: Hell's Abilities
hha.info.hell.1: Helmet — Undying Rage: At 3 hearts or less you gain Speed II.
hha.info.hell.2: Chestplate — Warlord's Barrier: Nearby living Brutes grant Resistance I and 2 absorption hearts.
hha.info.hell.3: Leggings — Lava Jesus: walk on lava; sneak to dive and jump to surface.
hha.info.hell.4: Leggings — Falling 6+ blocks triggers Magma Stomp lava and area damage, plus fireballs with a full set.
hha.info.hell.5: Ability 2: Fire Camp grants Regeneration IV and summons 3 allied Piglin Brutes.
hha.info.hell.6: Boots — Below 5 hearts, sprinting leaves a damaging fire trail.
hha.info.hell.7: Full set — Hellforged grants Strength I in fire/lava; Ability 1 fires the burning lava beam.
hha.info.hell.8: Hell's Sword — Crits grant absorption; right-click grants 20 s Haste III and auto-crits (90 s cooldown).
hha.info.hell.9: Hell's Mace — 8 base damage plus vanilla smash; right-click pulls enemies and hurts them on arrival.
hha.info.hell.10: Hell's Mace — Right-click a block/own projectile to grapple; floor targets arm a bounce dash.
hha.info.heaven.title: Heaven's Abilities
hha.info.heaven.1: Helmet — Halo: Trusted players within 5 blocks receive Regeneration I.
hha.info.heaven.2: Chestplate — Divine Shield: Once every 60 s, a lethal hit leaves you alive on 3 hearts.
hha.info.heaven.3: Leggings — Ascension: After the normal jump, 2 additional mid-air jumps are available.
hha.info.heaven.4: Leggings — Falling 6+ blocks triggers a damaging, knockback shockwave.
hha.info.heaven.5: Boots — Below 5 hearts, you leave a light trail that slows enemies.
hha.info.heaven.6: Full set — Sneak in mid-air to glide gently with Grace.
hha.info.heaven.7: Ability 1 fires a light beam: it damages enemies and heals/cleanses trusted players.
hha.info.heaven.8: Heaven's Sword — Every 3rd fully charged hit auto-crits; right-click creates the light wave.
hha.info.heaven.9: Light Wave damages and flings enemies; admins control its strength with light_wave_knockback.
hha.info.heaven.10: Heaven's Mace — 8 base damage plus vanilla smash; right-click throws it 50 blocks, strikes targets with lightning, and returns.
hha.info.ultra.title: Ultra Mode
hha.info.ultra.1: Ability 3 with a full set: HHA cooldowns are continuously removed for 60 seconds, followed by a 5-minute cooldown.
hha.info.ultra.2: Hell's Ultra: Strength II, Speed II, Fire Resistance, Resistance, and a burning damage aura.
hha.info.ultra.3: Heaven's Ultra: Regeneration II, Speed II, Resistance, Jump Boost II, and healing for allies.

item.hha.hermes_summons.lore1: No sender. The seal bears two serpents and a wing.
item.hha.hermes_summons.lore2: Right-click under the open sky: Hermes arrives to deliver.
item.hha.hermes_feather.lore1: Proof that you caught the messenger.
hha.hermes.title.forum.sub: All roads end here. Or cross.
hha.hermes.stage.2.sub: Only one casts a golden shadow.
hha.hermes.stage.3.sub: The way to the Styx is short.
hha.hermes.line.prologue.seal: The seal breaks. The letter burns without touching your hand.
hha.hermes.line.prologue.pull: The sky tears open above you — and something pulls you up.
hha.hermes.line.prologue.sender: Ah. For you. Sender: Olympus. Contents: armor that does not belong to you.
hha.hermes.line.prologue.condition: There is one condition: "The recipient must catch the messenger."
hha.hermes.line.prologue.apollo: Apollo tried it, after I stole his cattle. Argus had a hundred eyes. Not enough either.
hha.hermes.line.feather.falls: A single feather comes loose from his sandal. It is very quiet on the forum.
hha.hermes.line.feather.touched: You touched me. Me. Nobody has managed that in three thousand years.
hha.hermes.line.feather.other_job: Lovely! Then let me show you my other job.
hha.hermes.line.feather.thief: God of thieves, liars and crossroads. Guess which of us is real.
hha.hermes.line.descent.dead_know: You only know the Hermes who carries letters. The dead know another.
hha.hermes.line.descent.every_soul: Every soul that ever died, I led by the hand to the Styx. Every single one.
hha.hermes.line.descent.way_short: Come. I will show you the way. It is short.
hha.hermes.line.descent.serpents: May I introduce? These two, from the staff. They dislike visitors.
hha.hermes.line.zeus.name: HERMES.
hha.hermes.line.zeus.end_it: YOU ARE PLAYING WITH THIS MORTAL. END IT.
hha.hermes.line.zeus.fun: Honestly? I have not had this much fun in centuries.
hha.hermes.line.zeus.rule: So listen closely. The rule says: catch. It says nothing about "without wings".
hha.hermes.line.zeus.feather: The lost feather drifts down to you. Your feet grow light. You can now jump in mid-air.
hha.hermes.line.zeus.breath: He does not watch when I draw breath. Then — and only then.
hha.hermes.line.finale.catch: You reach out. And for the first time since the world began, the messenger of the gods stands still.
hha.hermes.line.finale.delivered: The armor of heaven, delivered to: you. Take care of it, it attracts trouble.
hha.hermes.line.finale.second_letter: Oh, and there is a second letter in my pocket. Sender: Hades.
hha.hermes.line.finale.hades_seal: The seal is still warm. He never writes twice.
hha.hermes.line.finale.another_day: But that is a problem for another day.
hha.hermes.line.finale.stinger: For a moment, the ground beneath your feet turns cold.
hha.hermes.fail.card: Recipient not found. Hermes leaves a card: "Try again."
hha.hermes.hint.invulnerable: Too fast! He cannot be hit right now.
hha.hermes.hint.fake: An illusion! Only the real one has the golden circle.
hha.hermes.hint.stones: Destroy the Herma stones! While they stand, Hermes is untouchable.
hha.hermes.hint.stagger: The stones have fallen. He staggers!
hha.hermes.hint.serpents: The serpents are loose. Kill both and Hermes staggers.
hha.hermes.hint.styx: The Styx is rising! Find the dry circle.
hha.hermes.hint.spear: Spears of Olympus! Get out of the circles.
hha.hermes.hint.jump: His last word: jump over the beams!
hha.hermes.hint.fall: A gust throws you back. "Not so fast, the delivery is still open."
hha.hermes.msg.disabled: The Hermes fight is disabled on this server.
hha.hermes.msg.busy: Hermes is busy in this dimension right now.
hha.hermes.msg.need_sky: The letter demands open sky above you.
item.hha.hades_map.lore1: Made of ash and ink. It smells of cold smoke.
item.hha.hades_map.lore2: Right-click in the Overworld: it shows the way down.
hha.hermes.hint.crowd: Hermes grows with you: %s opponents, more health, harder blows.
hha.olympus.altar: Carved into the stone: "Four gifts for the Messenger's first day. Begin where the sun begins, and follow it. Ask the stones if you are lost."
hha.olympus.riddle.0: The eastern stone whispers: "Born at dawn, and out of the cradle before breakfast. Bring what carries him."
hha.olympus.riddle.1: The southern stone whispers: "At noon he built the first thing that sings, out of a tortoise. Bring something that gives a tone when struck."
hha.olympus.riddle.2: The western stone whispers: "At dusk he drove Apollo's cattle away backwards, so the tracks would lie. Bring what remains of such a cow."
hha.olympus.riddle.3: The northern stone whispers: "At night Zeus found him a job. Bring what a messenger carries his messages on."
hha.olympus.taken: This stone has already been fed.
hha.olympus.wrong_gift: Somewhere, someone laughs. That was the wrong gift, and the stones have forgotten everything.
hha.olympus.wrong_order: The sun does not run backwards, even if his cattle do. The stones have forgotten everything.
hha.hades.altar: Scratched into the stone: "The ferryman takes one currency. A single coin, laid under the tongue."
hha.hades.map.wrong_world: The map only points down from the Overworld.
hha.hades.map.nothing: The ink does not move. No way leads down around here.
hha.hades.map.read: The map burns itself into your memory. The entrance is about %s blocks away.
hha.hades.map.found: Between the feathers lies a singed scrap. It is what remained of the black letter: a map.
hha.shade.stage.3.sub: The serpents are at home here.
hha.shade.stage.4.sub: Strike when he draws breath. If he still needs any.
hha.tartaros.arrive: Tartarus. Nobody has ever received mail here.
hha.hermes.line.prologue.altar: The gifts burn away on the stones. The altar grows hot, and the sky above the temple tears open.
hha.hermes.line.shade.coin: The coin drops into the bowl and does not stop falling. At the edge of the hall, green flames awaken.
hha.hermes.line.shade.who: Delivery! Just not from the one you know.
hha.hermes.line.shade.ash: He burned the black letter. But ash can read. And I am what rose out of the ash.
hha.hermes.line.shade.contract: New employer, new job: the recipient does not reach the gate.
hha.hermes.line.shade.wings: You caught his wings. Mine are made of smoke.
hha.hermes.line.shade.snakes: You have met these two. Down here they prefer to bite.
hha.hermes.line.shade.voice: A voice from the ground says a single word, and the hall holds its breath: Continue.
hha.hermes.line.shade.breath: He says I should hurry. I say: you draw breath first.
hha.hermes.line.shade.contract_end: That … was not in the contract.
hha.hermes.line.shade.gate: The gate opens for whoever beats the messenger. A bad clause. Not one of mine.
hha.hermes.line.shade.warning: Go on. Nobody over there gives you wings.
hha.hermes.line.shade.open: The shade crumbles. Behind the black gate it burns green, and it does not stop.
hha.tartaros.title: Tartarus
hha.tartaros.title.sub: Nobody has ever received mail here.
hha.tartaros.palace: Before you rises the sealed gate of Hades. It stays shut. For now.
hha.hermes.line.guide.follow: This way. Do not stop, or you will stay forever.
hha.hermes.line.guide.slow: You are slow. The dead were faster, and they were in no hurry.
hha.hermes.line.guide.back: Do not look back. Somebody tried that once.
hha.hermes.line.guide.end: Not even I may go further. He is expecting you.
